inscl.title: Insurance statements
inscl.lead: A statement per insurance company with its invoices and share for a period — Excel or PDF, or e-mailed to the company as attachments.
inscl.f_email_help: Claims statements are sent to it (PDF + Excel).
inscl.attached: The statement is attached as PDF and Excel.
inscl.no_email_help: Add the company's e-mail in Settings → Insurance, or type it here.
inscl.lang: Language of the message and statement
inscl.empty: No insurance invoices for this company in the period
inscl.no_companies_text: Add the insurance companies the clinic works with first.
inscl.how_text: Every invoice of the period where the insurance company pays a part, with its share as recorded at the cashier. Default period: last month.
inscl.pdf_note: Amounts as invoiced by the clinic in the period shown; diagnoses as ICD-10 codes recorded by the doctor.

err.NO_EMAIL: This company has no e-mail — add or type one.
err.NO_MAIL: E-mail is not set up — connect the clinic's mail in Settings.
err.MAIL_FAILED: The e-mail could not be sent; try again later.
err.EMPTY: There are no invoices to send for this period.

msg.subject: Claims statement {company} — {clinic} ({from} – {to})
msg.body:
Dear {company},
Please find attached the claims statement of {clinic} for {from} to {to}: {count} invoices, insurer's share {total}.
The statement is attached as PDF and Excel.
Kind regards,
{clinic}
